description: This file implements the LifecycleManager class for managing application lifecycle events, including registration of notifications, handling runtime and window manager events, and controlling application states such as spawn, unload, kill, and send intent. It interacts with other components like RequestHandler and ApplicationContext to manage application lifecycle within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: LifecycleManagerImplementation
classes.description: Implements the lifecycle management logic for applications, including event dispatching, notification registration, and application state control within the WPEFramework plugin.

classes.name: ApplicationContext
classes.description: Represents the context of a loaded application, including its ID, state, and synchronization primitives.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the lifecycle manager with the provided service.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Cleans up resources and terminates the lifecycle manager.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for lifecycle events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered notification callback.

methods.name: dispatchEvent
methods.description: Dispatches an event to be processed asynchronously.

methods.name: Dispatch
methods.description: Handles the dispatching of lifecycle events based on the event type.

methods.name: GetLoadedApps
methods.description: Retrieves the list of currently loaded applications with optional verbose details.

methods.name: IsAppLoaded
methods.description: Checks if an application with the given ID is loaded.

methods.name: SpawnApp
methods.description: Launches a new application asynchronously.

methods.name: SetTargetAppState
methods.description: Changes the target state of a loaded application.

methods.name: UnloadApp
methods.description: Initiates a graceful shutdown of an application.

methods.name: KillApp
methods.description: Forcefully terminates an application.

methods.name: SendIntentToActiveApp
methods.description: Sends an intent (deeplink) to an active application.

methods.name: AppReady
methods.description: Signals that an application is ready.

methods.name: StateChangeComplete
methods.description: Indicates completion of a state change for an application.

methods.name: CloseApp
methods.description: Closes an application with a specified reason.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the lifecycle manager with the provided service.

methods.name: getContext
methods.description: Retrieves the application context for a given app instance ID or app ID.

methods.name: onRuntimeManagerEvent
methods.description: Handles runtime manager events and dispatches them.

methods.name: onWindowManagerEvent
methods.description: Handles window manager events and dispatches them.

methods.name: onRippleEvent
methods.description: Placeholder for handling ripple events (not implemented).

methods.name: onStateChangeEvent
methods.description: Handles application state change events.

methods.name: handleRuntimeManagerEvent
methods.description: Processes specific runtime manager events such as termination, state change, failure, and start.

methods.name: handleStateChangeEvent
methods.description: Handles application state change events, including cleanup when an app is unloaded.

methods.name: handleWindowManagerEvent
methods.description: Processes window manager events like user inactivity, disconnect, and readiness.
